summary: This table presents the Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income for Infosys for the nine months ending December 31, 2025, and December 31, 2024. It details key financial metrics including revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit. Notably, revenues increased by 8.3% from the previous year, while operating profit saw a modest growth of 2.6%. The operating margin remained relatively stable, and the basic EPS rose by 6.6%. The adjustments for labor codes are also highlighted, indicating a significant impact on reported figures. Overall, the data reflects a positive trend in financial performance despite some increases in operating expenses.
table_rows: Cost of sales: Dec 31 2025 = 92,676, Dec 31 2024 = 84,771, Growth % = 9.3
Total Operating Expenses: Dec 31 2025 = 13,061, Dec 31 2024 = 11,444, Growth % = 14.1
Net Profit (after non-controlling interests): Dec 31 2025 = 20,939, Dec 31 2024 = 19,680, Growth % = 6.4
